description.en: Personal WeChat and WeCom (企业微信) for DeepSeek Harness: pair WeChat accounts by scanning a QR code in the Plugins panel, then talk to your agent with one DSH conversation per contact or group. Text, images, video, documents and archives travel both ways; inbound media is decrypted to $DSH_HOME/wechat-inbox as a path for the model. Sensitive operations are approved from the chat (1 = allow once, 2 = reject; a timeout falls back to the GUI), and a card lists every chat (Allow / Ignore / Clear) plus an optional allowlist. A switch can restrict the bot to 1:1 chats, dropping group messages silently (counted, never invisible). WeCom works three ways: a group-robot webhook, a self-built app, and a two-way robot over its long connection - messages, images, files and videos go both ways, with no public URL. Chat commands (/help, /status, /new, /stop, /friends) are answered by the bridge itself, costing no model turn. State persists under $DSH_HOME. No runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的个人微信 + 企业微信桥：在插件面板扫码配对，之后在微信或企业微信里和 agent 对话，每个联系人/群各自一个独立 DSH 会话。文字、图片、视频、文档、压缩包双向互通；收到的媒体解密落盘到 $DSH_HOME/wechat-inbox 并以路径交给模型。敏感操作可在聊天里直接审批（回 1 批准一次、回 2 拒绝，超时自动转回 GUI），卡片面板列出所有联系人与群，可逐条允许/忽略/清除，并可开启「只接收白名单」。「只处理好友私聊」开关可让机器人只回单聊，群消息静默忽略但会计数。企业微信有三条链路：群机器人 webhook、自建应用、以及双向的智能机器人长连接——消息、图片、文件、视频都能收发，且无需公网地址。聊天里支持 /help、/status、/new、/stop、/friends 命令，由桥自己直接应答，不消耗模型回合。状态持久化在 $DSH_HOME。无外部服务、无运行时依赖。
